note: WHERE THE LOADED PACKAGE STOPS, which is the honest measure this phase owes and the demand signal the next one starts from. Eight representative calls, each catching `void-function' and answering the NAME that was missing rather than a message, so the record reads as a list of frontier names instead of a diagnostic. Emacs answers all eight: ("a-b-c" "bXnXnX" "ABC" "abab" "hi" t t 3). kg answers the first four and stops at three names on the other four -- ("a-b-c" "bXnXnX" "ABC" "abab" save-match-data string-match-p string-equal save-match-data) -- so the frontier moved from the READER to the match-data surface, which is exactly what makes it a Phase 25/26 question rather than a Phase 24 failure. The four that work are not a coincidence either: `s-join' is `mapconcat' and `s-repeat' is a loop, both of which Phase 24 had to generalise anyway.
